payload.question: Some of your older requests still promise things this branch removed on purpose: a line at the end of a turn naming the questions that were withdrawn or settled, answering questions in the browser study room, and keeping the judge's judgments and offers in git. Do your newer decisions in this work (one next action, no cards, judgments kept as telemetry only) replace those older words?
